samples.claim: num_runs returns starts.len; present_len directly indexes terminal prefix. Private start_or_span returns supplied run start or span sentinel; missing_before(k)=start_or_span(k)-present_before[k]; end(k)=starts[k]+missing_before(k+1)-missing_before(k). These O(1) helpers assume constructor invariants and valid private indices.
samples.review_note: Matches exact constant-time vector accesses and prefix formulas; private indices rely on constructor invariants.

samples.claim: Custom Serialize emits exactly seven named fields: path, fields, column_indices, file_major_version, file_minor_version, file_size_bytes, base_id. Arc arrays serialize as slices, making JSON arrays transparent; serializer errors propagate. It does not sort, validate or omit None base IDs.
samples.review_note: Matches seven unconditional serialized fields and Arc slice projection; errors propagate with question marks.

samples.claim: Separate cfg(test) registry module imports config/URI APIs and serialization lock. Config and URI success tests check concrete backend capacity1048576 then also invoke registry route for successful construction. They hold registry_test_lock to coordinate other mutation tests.

samples.claim: Transaction::new_from_version(read_version,operation) delegates new+build, leaving tag/properties None. Transaction::new(read_version,operation,tag) adds tag setter then build. samples.review_note: Matches both constructors; complete builder file read this turn confirms lazy UUID generation/defaults and no commit/test/async code.

samples.claim: HashMap<K,V,S> supports any hasher type parameter and estimates backing storage as capacity*(size_of::<K>()+size_of::<V>()+1), then adds live key/value children. The comment calls the one-byte term approximate control metadata and notes capacity/buckets; the code uses reported capacity directly. Alignment, allocator overhead and exact table layout are not measured, so this is an estimate.
samples.review_note: Matches generic hasher parameter, capacity estimate and live child sum; no claim of exact layout/allocator measurement.

samples.claim: set_dictionary dispatches eight integer dictionary key types to arr.as_dictionary::<T>().values() and panics on any other dictionary key type. Struct converts its field definitions, finds each mutable child by name with unwrap, casts arr.as_struct and recursively attaches column dictionaries. List/LargeList cast to i32/i64 list arrays and recurse into children[0]. Other types are no-ops, including Map and FixedSizeList. Array shape/type and child presence are caller invariants enforced only by casts/indexing/unwrap, not a Result boundary.
samples.review_note: Matches eight integer key cases, nested struct/list recursion, no-op fallback and panic assumptions.

samples.claim: ManifestBuildConfig is a data-only public Debug/Clone struct with auto_set_feature_flags, resolved timestamp_nanos, use_stable_row_ids, optional legacy mode/storage_format, disable_transaction_file, migration_next_row_id and Arc<SpilledRowLineage>. Docs specify sticky row IDs, overwrite-only storage override precedence, migration bypass and prefetched spilled sequences needed for rewrite/update; no enforcement/default implementation occurs in this file. Clock resolution deliberately belongs to caller; cfg(test) clock mocking in lance is a source comment, consumer implementation pending.
